readmeMarkdown:
# Rivul

Search more than 300 million scholarly paper records by meaning, open the full
record for any result, and run literature reviews with research skills, from
inside Antigravity.

Rivul AI (https://rivul.ai) is free for everyone. No payment and no AI key are
needed.

## Install and sign in

1. Install the plugin from `/plugin` in the Antigravity CLI, or run
   `agy plugin install <path-to-this-folder>`.
2. Sign in when Antigravity shows the `Connect Rivul` screen. If you skipped it,
   open `/mcp`, select `rivul_rivul` (it shows `Auth Needed`) and press Enter.
3. Sign in with Google in the browser and choose `Allow requested access`.
   `/mcp` then shows `rivul_rivul [Authed]` with three tools.

## What it adds

**Rivul MCP server** (`https://rivul.ai/mcp`, OAuth sign-in, read-only):

- `search_papers`: semantic search with optional filters for year range,
  minimum citations, open access only, topic and field, sorted by relevance,
  most cited, newest or oldest.
- `get_paper_details`: the full record for one work: every author held, venue,
  work type, topic, field, publication date and open-access links.
- `usage_status`: your workspace's MCP usage for the current day.

Results come only from the index, never from a model. Each carries a stable
OpenAlex ID so you can check the source; records come from a dated OpenAlex
snapshot, and the snapshot date is returned with every response.

**Research skills** (from Rivul's Research Agent Skills, MIT):

| Skill | Use it to |
|---|---|
| `building-search-strings` | Build reproducible Boolean search strings from a research question and test them |
| `conducting-scoping-reviews` | Plan and run a scoping review with the JBI method, reported against PRISMA-ScR |
| `mapping-literature` | Map a topic into clusters of work, anchor papers and a timeline |
| `chasing-citations` | Run backward and forward citation searching |
| `evaluating-citation-faithfulness` | Check whether citations in AI-generated answers support their statements |
| `writing-literature-reviews` | Plan and write a narrative review article |

## Example prompts

- Find the most cited open-access papers on retrieval-augmented generation since 2020
- Build a search string for a scoping review on microplastics in drinking water
- Chase citations forward and backward from this paper's OpenAlex ID

## Links

- Setup and docs: https://rivul.ai/features/atlas
- Tool reference: https://rivul.ai/help/atlas-tools
- Privacy: https://rivul.ai/privacy
